study.title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Precision Agriculture: A Study on Crop Segmentation based on UAV Remote Sensing Data
study.short_title: LoRA-tuned VLMs (Qwen2-VL) for crop segmentation via coordinate text

segmentation.domain: crop-type classification (semantic segmentation) of corn (Zea mays), barley (Hordeum vulgare) and tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum) from UAV RGB imagery, reformulated as text-based polygon-coordinate generation by vision-language models
segmentation.best_model: Qwen2-VL-7B (LoRA fine-tuned): overall F1 0.4916, IoU 0.4661; best crop tobacco F1 0.7842, IoU 0.7564

dataset.name: UAV RGB crop dataset, Xingren City, Guizhou Province, China (4 very-high-resolution orthoimages)
dataset.note: 4 large UAV RGB images (18,576x68,363 to 55,128x49,447 px, ~1.8 GB each) acquired with commercial UAV platforms during peak growing season, split into 512x512 sub-images -> 11,750 total (9,413 train / 2,337 test, ~4:1); pixel-level single-channel masks for corn/barley/tobacco. Acquisition platform, altitude and GSD not reported.

segmentation.backbone: Vision-language LLM backbones (Qwen2-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLaVA-1.5-7B, LLaMA3-LLaVA-Next-8B) with frozen CLIP ViT visual encoders + trainable projection layer; LoRA adapters (rank 8) on LLM attention query/value projections; segmentation via XML-wrapped polygon coordinate sequence generation

mIoU.ambiguity: No mean-IoU reported. Paper reports per-crop IoU and overall (micro, pixel-level) IoU in Table III; best model (Qwen2-VL-7B) overall IoU 0.4661, corn 0.2801 / barley 0.3673 / tobacco 0.7564 (mean of per-class ~0.468).

mPA.ambiguity: Precision (micro) 0.5325 and recall 0.4799 reported for best model (Table III) but mean-per-class pixel accuracy not reported.

F1.quote: Qwen2-VL achieves the best overall performance with an F1-score of 49.16% and IoU of 46.61%, significantly outperforming other models.
F1.ambiguity: Overall F1 0.4916 for best model Qwen2-VL-7B (pixel-level, micro aggregate). Other models: Qwen2.5-VL-7B 0.4036, LLaVA-1.5-7B 0.3332, LLaMA3-LLaVA-Next-8B 0.2312.

crop_F1.quote: Notably, tobacco segmentation shows superior results (F1: 78.42%, IoU: 75.64%) compared to corn and barley
crop_F1.ambiguity: Best crop class (tobacco) F1 0.7842 for Qwen2-VL-7B; corn 0.3266, barley 0.4000. Per-class values are per-crop-type, not crop-vs-background.

edge.framework: LoRA (rank 8, bf16, AdamW, lr 1e-4, cosine w/ warmup 0.1, 3 epochs, effective batch 8); inference and training on GPU (details not given)

params_M.ambiguity: LLM sizes (7B/8B) listed in Table I but no deployment/edge relevance; LoRA trainable params much smaller. Not recorded.

issues: VLM text-generation paradigm (coordinate/XML sequences converted back to masks), not conventional per-pixel deep segmentation; accuracies far below dedicated segmentation models.
No edge deployment discussion, latency, throughput, or FLOPs; models are 7-8B VLMs (LoRA fine-tuned) trained/inferred on GPU.
UAV platform, flight altitude and GSD not reported; only image pixel dimensions (18,576x68,363 to 55,128x49,447) and ~1.8 GB size.
No PA/mPA/Dice reported; pixel-level F1/IoU/precision/recall only (Table III); no mean-IoU (per-class IoU available).
